definitions.after_hash: + the Bern answers OPD holds without a parent (relink + review rows): after OPD's hash rule for relinks
definitions.all: + the answers fetched and checked from the parliaments, still to be fetched into OPD
definitions.attached: text attached to the intervention in OPD (the registered census count)

definitions.with_agenda: also counting answers OPD files under an agenda item of the same affair (census link_status agenda); these 592 are also among the 9,580 counted repairs
